component.name: Screenshot
component.summary: Take a screenshot, mark it up, save or copy it

description.p: Capture a screen, a window or a region, then point things out with arrows, boxes, numbers, text and highlights, or pixelate what should stay private. Copy the result, save it, or open it in another application.

ul.li: Capture now or after a delay, with or without the pointer
Crop, annotate and undo in the same view
Open an existing image or one from the clipboard to mark it up
A command line for scripts and agents
